name: agent-chat
summary: Multi-agent LangGraph chat with tool execution and SSE streaming
description: Stateful LLM chat endpoint supporting three agents (kai, interior-designer, demo). Uses LangGraph StateGraph for multi-step tool execution. Supports multimodal input (data-URL images), long-term memory, toolkit-based tool selection, and optional partner API key access. Returns SSE stream of JSON chunks; content-type text/event-stream.

agentId.description: Agent to invoke; legacy aliases search/insights/seo resolve to kai

images.description: User-attached images as data URLs (data:image/jpeg;base64,...) or HTTP URLs

conversation_id.description: Supabase conversation ID; used to post background task results back

pinned_material_images.description: Catalog product image URLs pinned for Gemini multi-reference generation

generation_mode.description: Optional generation mode hint passed through to generation tools

selected_toolkits.description: Active toolkit cluster IDs; null means Core tools only plus load_toolkit meta-tool

user_id.description: Only honored when the caller authenticates with service-role/admin key (server-to-server act-on-behalf). Ignored for user-JWT and partner-key calls.

name: agent-scheduler-cron
summary: Every-minute cron: dispatch background agents whose cron schedule is due
description: Runs every minute via pg_cron. Evaluates all enabled background_agents with trigger_type='cron', parses their cron expression, and dispatches due agents to background-agent-runner. Includes concurrency guard to skip agents with an in-flight run.
response: { success, checked, triggered, results: [{ agent_id, name, triggered, run_id?, error? }] }

name: ai-pricing-updater
summary: Weekly cron (Sunday 00:00 UTC): sync AI model prices from hardcoded reference tables
description: Reads ai_model_pricing rows with auto_update_enabled=true, compares current prices against a hardcoded per-provider reference (Anthropic, OpenAI, Voyage, Google, Firecrawl), updates changed rows, and writes an audit row to ai_pricing_update_logs. Accepts optional POST body to force-update or filter by provider.

request.name: force_update
request.desc: Ignore auto_update_enabled flag; check all rows

request.name: provider
request.desc: Limit update to one provider (anthropic, openai, voyage, google, firecrawl)

response: { success, message, stats: { models_checked, models_updated, models_skipped, models_failed, results }, timestamp }

name: auto-recovery-cron
summary: Every-5-minute cron: detect and recover stuck PDF, XML, scraping, and agent runs
description: Scans background_jobs, scraping_sessions, and agent_runs for heartbeat-stale entries. Atomically claims each and re-dispatches to MIVAA or background-agent-runner. Terminally-failed exhausted PDF jobs are marked failed and HuggingFace endpoints are scaled to zero as a cost watchdog.
response: { success, totalStuck, exhausted_failed, recovered, failed, results }

name: background-agent-runner
summary: Execute a registered background agent by agent_id
description: Universal executor for all background agent types. Accepts service-role or user JWT auth. GET ?catalog=1 returns the registered agent type catalog; POST runs or resumes an agent run.

actions.name: run_agent
actions.summary: Run or resume a background agent

params.name: run_id
params.desc: Resume or update an existing pending run

params.name: input_data
params.desc: Override or augment agent config input

actions.name: get_catalog
actions.summary: Return registered agent type catalog (GET ?catalog=1)

request.name: agent_id
request.desc: ID from background_agents table

request.name: run_id
request.desc: Resume an existing pending run

request.name: input_data
request.desc: Override or augment config input

request.name: triggered_by
request.desc: cron | event | manual | chain | api

name: campaign-processor
summary: Every-minute cron: start scheduled campaigns and drip-send emails to recipients
description: Transitions campaigns from status='scheduled' to 'sending' when their scheduled_at has elapsed. Then processes up to 8 pending recipients per campaign per tick by calling the email-api edge function. Marks campaigns complete (sent or partial_failure) when all recipients are exhausted.

name: canonicalize-attributes
summary: Proxy product attribute canonicalization to MIVAA facet service
description: Internal-only thin proxy called by background agents (material-tagger, product-enrichment) to canonicalize raw product attributes through MIVAA's POST /api/admin/facets/canonicalize. Keeps MIVAA credentials in one place so background agents do not need to carry them. No auth enforced at the edge layer — network-level restriction applies.

raw_attributes.description: Record of raw attribute key→value pairs to canonicalize

attributes_raw.description: Record<string, string[]> of every raw value seen

name: catalog-access
summary: Public email-gate for shared catalog pages (/c/:slug)
description: Handles access requests, token verification, public metadata, and view/download tracking for published catalogs. No authentication header required; uses service role internally.

actions.name: public_meta
actions.summary: Return title, subtitle, cover image and owner branding for the gate landing page

actions.name: request
actions.summary: Verify email eligibility and mint a 30-day cookie token if matched

actions.name: verify
actions.summary: Validate an existing cookie token and return the full catalog payload

actions.name: track_view
actions.summary: Record a page_view event for analytics; increments view counter

actions.name: track_download
actions.summary: Record a pdf_download event for analytics

name: catalog-extract-from-pdfs
summary: Claude Sonnet vision pass over source PDFs to find materials matching a query
description: Sends one or more admin-uploaded source PDFs to Claude Sonnet 4.6 with tool-use to extract candidate materials matching a free-form query. Returns candidates with name, description, price, specs, bbox, and a rasterized image URL.

request.name: catalog_id
request.desc: Target catalog ID (for cost logging)

request.name: source_pdf_ids
request.desc: IDs of catalog_source_pdfs rows to search

request.name: query
request.desc: Free-form search query describing desired materials

request.name: max_results
request.desc: Max candidates to return (default 12, max 40)

request.name: caller_user_id
request.desc: User ID for ai_usage_logs cost attribution

name: catalog-image-search
summary: Find candidate images for a catalog material via platform DB then web fallback
description: Searches the platform product DB (via MIVAA multi-vector search) first, then falls back to DataForSEO Google Images SERP. Returns up to N image candidates tagged with source ('db' or 'web') for admin approval.

request.name: query
request.desc: Material name / search query

request.name: max_candidates
request.desc: Max results (default 6, max 12)

request.name: search_db_first
request.desc: Whether to query platform DB before web (default true)

request.name: caller_user_id
request.desc: User ID for logging

name: catalog-render-pdf-page
summary: Proxy to MIVAA rasterize-pdf-page; returns signed URL to a PNG crop of a PDF page
description: Thin edge proxy that forwards a rasterization request to MIVAA's internal endpoint using the cron secret. Accepts an optional normalized [0..1] bbox to crop a region of the page. Called internally by catalog-extract-from-pdfs and catalog-translate-pdf.

request.name: source_pdf_id
request.desc: catalog_source_pdfs row ID

request.name: page_no
request.desc: 1-based page number to rasterize

request.name: bbox
request.desc: Normalized [0..1] crop region {x1,y1,x2,y2}

request.name: dpi
request.desc: Output DPI (default 150)

request.name: target_path
request.desc: Override storage path for the output PNG

request.name: signed_url_ttl_seconds
request.desc: Signed URL TTL in seconds

name: catalog-send-to-customers
summary: Admin sends a published catalog to CRM-category recipients via email
description: Resolves recipients from CRM categories, optionally writes catalog_email_grants for each, then dispatches emails via email-api using the catalog_send.recipient template. Preview mode returns recipient list without sending.

actions.name: preview
actions.summary: Resolve recipient list from CRM categories without sending any emails

params.name: category_ids
params.desc: CRM category IDs to resolve recipients from

actions.name: send
actions.summary: Dispatch catalog emails to all resolved recipients and log each send

params.name: category_ids
params.desc: CRM category IDs to resolve recipients from

params.name: message_body
params.desc: Optional personal message included in template

params.name: ensure_grants
params.desc: Write catalog_email_grants for every recipient before sending

name: catalog-translate-pdf
summary: Whole-PDF vision pass to populate a catalog's body_data from a source PDF
description: Sends an entire source PDF to Claude Sonnet 4.6 via tool-use to produce sections and materials, then merges the result into the target catalog's body_data. Supports layout-preserving (page-per-section) and restructured (category-grouped) modes.

request.name: source_pdf_id
request.desc: catalog_source_pdfs row ID to translate

request.name: target_catalog_id
request.desc: presentation_catalogs row to write body_data into

request.name: preserve_original_layout
request.desc: One section per PDF page when true; category-grouped when false (default)

request.name: caller_user_id
request.desc: User ID for ai_usage_logs cost attribution

name: check-material-alerts
summary: Daily cron (08:00 UTC) that matches new products against active saved searches and sends bell notifications.
description: Can also be triggered manually via POST (no secret required — uses service-role JWT from pg_cron Authorization header). For each active saved_search not yet due to re-alert, queries products created since last_recommendation_sent_at whose name or description matches the saved query, inserts deduped material_alerts rows, and writes user_notifications.

name: crawl-user-website
summary: Sitemap-driven indexer for SEO inter-linking; preview or full crawl mode
description: Discovers the sitemap via robots.txt or well-known paths, then either samples 5 URLs (mode=preview) or fully crawls up to max_pages URLs (mode=full), scraping each with Firecrawl and embedding the content via Voyage for SEO inter-linking. Accepts JWT or cron secret.

request.name: website_id
request.desc: user_websites row ID to crawl

request.name: mode
request.desc: preview (5-URL sample, no full index) or full (default)

name: crm-api
summary: REST CRM resource router for companies, contacts, users, and Stripe.
description: Path-routed REST API dispatching to four resource handlers: /companies (GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE for company CRUD, requires admin or factory role), /contacts (contact CRUD), /users (user profile CRUD), /stripe (Stripe customer/subscription operations). Each handler performs its own auth and RLS enforcement.

name: email-api
summary: Action-discriminated email sending, domain management, logs, and analytics via Resend.
description: Accepts a JSON body with an `action` field (or path suffix) to select the operation. Requires `RESEND_API_KEY`; returns 503 with `provider_not_configured` when absent. Supports optional React Email templates resolved by slug from `email_templates`.

actions.name: send
actions.summary: Send a transactional/marketing email via Resend, with optional template.

params.name: subject
params.desc: Email subject (may be overridden by template)

params.name: html
params.desc: HTML body (required if no templateSlug and no text)

params.name: templateSlug
params.desc: Slug of an active email_templates row

actions.name: domains
actions.summary: List configured sending domains.

actions.name: add-domain
actions.summary: Register a new sending domain (admin only).

actions.name: mark-domain-verified
actions.summary: Mark a domain as verified after DNS confirmation (admin only).

actions.name: logs
actions.summary: Retrieve email send logs with optional status/type filters.

actions.name: analytics
actions.summary: Return aggregated email delivery/engagement stats for a date range.

params.name: dateRange
params.desc: ISO date range (POST body) or fromDate/toDate query params (GET)

actions.response: {success:true, totalSent, totalDelivered, totalBounced, deliveryRate, bounceRate, openRate, clickRate, dailyData}

actions.name: sync-domains
actions.summary: Pull domain list from Resend and upsert into email_domains (admin only).

request.name: action
request.desc: One of: send, domains, add-domain, mark-domain-verified, logs, analytics, sync-domains

name: email-webhooks
summary: Receives Resend delivery event webhooks and updates email_logs.
description: Accepts POST from Resend (Svix-signed). Verifies HMAC-SHA256 signature using `RESEND_WEBHOOK_SECRET` and rejects requests with missing or invalid Svix headers. Maps Resend event types (sent, delivered, bounced, complained, opened, clicked) to internal `email_events` rows and updates `email_logs` status accordingly.

request.name: type
request.desc: Resend event type, e.g. email.delivered

request.name: created_at
request.desc: ISO timestamp of the event

request.name: data
request.desc: Event data including email_id, from, to, subject; bounce/click details when applicable

name: finance-digest-aggregate
summary: Send finance digest emails and dispatch quote follow-up bell notifications
description: Cron mode (invoked by the Finance digest flow): sends scheduled digest emails with AR/AP aging, cash-flow forecast, P&L, and top-party tables to configured recipients, and dispatches bell notifications for idle or due-scheduled quotes. Now mode (admin JWT): sends an on-demand digest for a specific workspace.

request.name: mode
request.desc: 'cron' for scheduled invocation from flow-engine; 'now' for admin-triggered send.

request.name: job
request.desc: Narrow cron run to one job; omit to run both.

request.name: workspace_id
request.desc: now mode: target workspace; inferred from caller's membership if omitted.

request.name: recipients_override
request.desc: now mode: override recipient list (skips last_sent stamp).

response: {ok, digest?: {processed, dispatched, results}, followups?: {dispatched, skipped, queue_size}, recipients_attempted?, recipients_delivered?, errors?}

name: finance-fiscal-offline-recovery
summary: Re-query connector for pending MARK on offline-accepted fiscal documents
description: Cron function that finds invoices and credit notes with fiscal_status='offline' (accepted by the connector while AADE was down) and calls fetchTransmitted on the connector to stamp the final MARK. Safe to run continuously; no-ops when nothing is pending.

name: finance-inbound-sync
summary: Pull inbound documents from myDATA (RequestDocs) for configured workspaces
description: Polls the AADE myDATA RequestDocs endpoint for each workspace that has configured inbound credentials, upserts received documents into inbound_documents, and advances the per-workspace MARK watermark. The manual 'Sync from myDATA' path may bound the pull to an issue-date window (date_from/date_to) so a sync doesn't drag in years of history. Cron path charges 2 credits per workspace; manual 'Sync now' (JWT) is free. No-ops cleanly when credentials are absent.

request.name: date_from
request.desc: Manual path only. Start of the issue-date window to pull. Must be sent together with date_to and be <= it; sent to AADE as dateFrom in dd/MM/yyyy. Omit both to pull from the stored MARK watermark.

request.name: date_to
request.desc: Manual path only. End of the issue-date window to pull. Must be sent together with date_from.

response: {ok, workspaces, results: [{workspaceId, found, upserted, new_watermark, date_from?, date_to?} | {workspaceId, skipped|error}]}

name: finance-invoice-pdf
summary: Render a legal invoice, credit note, or delivery note as a PDF
description: Generates an A4 PDF for an invoice, credit note, or delivery note using pdf-lib with embedded Noto Sans for Greek/Latin rendering. Caches the PDF in pdf-documents storage and returns a 7-day signed URL. Supports GR/EN language selection per-document.

request.name: invoice_id
request.desc: Invoice to render. Provide one of: invoice_id, credit_note_id, delivery_note_id.

request.name: credit_note_id
request.desc: Credit note to render.

request.name: delivery_note_id
request.desc: Delivery note to render.

request.name: regenerate
request.desc: Force re-render even if a cached PDF exists.

name: finance-issue-invoice
summary: Issue, transmit, or POS-complete a fiscal invoice/credit note/delivery note
description: Creates a draft invoice from a quote (idempotent), optionally issues it, and optionally transmits it to the workspace's legal_invoice connector (Novus → myDATA). Also handles credit-note submission (myDATA 5.1), delivery-note submission (9.3), and POS/IRIS receipt hold + completion (Law 5155). Costs 2 credits per myDATA transmission; root workspace transmits free.

request.name: quote_id
request.desc: Create/find invoice from this quote. Provide this OR invoice_id.

request.name: invoice_id
request.desc: Operate on an existing invoice directly.

request.name: credit_note_id
request.desc: Submit a credit note (myDATA 5.1) to the fiscal connector.

request.name: delivery_note_id
request.desc: Submit a delivery note (myDATA 9.3) to the fiscal connector.

request.name: issue_now
request.desc: Flip invoice from draft → issued status.

request.name: submit_fiscal
request.desc: Transmit to the workspace's legal_invoice connector.

request.name: skip_signature
request.desc: Skip provider digital-signature step (Novus ?skipSignature=true).

request.name: fiscal_overrides
request.desc: Per-call myDATA overrides: invoice type, series/aa, income classification.

request.name: pos_payment
request.desc: Issue as card/IRIS receipt on a registered EFT-POS terminal (Law 5155).

request.name: pos_complete
request.desc: Finalize a held POS/IRIS receipt after terminal charge succeeded.

response: {ok, invoice_id, invoice, fiscal: {ok, status, mark, uid, qrUrl, ...} | null}

name: finance-pay-invoice
summary: Create a Stripe Checkout session or pay-link for an invoice
description: Two modes: authenticated admin/finance mints a pay_token and/or creates a Stripe Checkout session for an invoice; public/unauthenticated path resolves a pay_token and creates a Checkout session for the buyer. Routes funds to the workspace's connected Stripe account when configured.

request.name: invoice_id
request.desc: Admin mode: invoice to pay. Requires JWT with finance role.

request.name: link_only
request.desc: Admin mode: mint/refresh pay_token + return public link without creating a Checkout session.

request.name: pay_token
request.desc: Public mode: token from the pay link (e.g. from /pay/:token URL).

request.name: success_url
request.desc: Redirect URL on payment success.

request.name: cancel_url
request.desc: Redirect URL on payment cancellation.

response: {ok, checkout_url, session_id, invoice_id, pay_link?, pay_token?, amount?, currency?, customer_display?}

name: finance-send-invoice-email
summary: Email an invoice to its customer with optional PDF attachment
description: Resolves the recipient from the invoice's CRM company/contact, generates or reuses the invoice PDF, and dispatches via the email-api edge function. The 'to' field overrides automatic recipient resolution.

request.name: invoice_id
request.desc: Invoice to email.

request.name: to
request.desc: Override recipient email; defaults to CRM customer email on file.

name: finance-send-statement
summary: Render and email a party account-statement PDF (ledger / Καρτέλα)
description: Single mode: renders a chronological debit/credit ledger PDF for a CRM company or contact and emails it. Cron-batch mode: iterates all workspaces with auto_statement_enabled and sends each eligible party their statement according to the configured schedule. Customer-side statements include pay-by-card links for open invoices.

request.name: mode
request.desc: Pass 'cron_batch' with x-cron-secret header to run the automated batch.

request.name: party_type
request.desc: Single mode: party type. Required unless mode='cron_batch'.

request.name: party_id
request.desc: Single mode: CRM company or contact ID.

request.name: side
request.desc: Ledger direction; inferred from party flags if omitted.

request.name: from
request.desc: Period start; defaults to current year start.

request.name: to
request.desc: Period end; defaults to current year end.

request.name: lang
request.desc: PDF/email language; inferred from workspace country if omitted.

request.name: email
request.desc: Override recipient email.

request.name: dry_run
request.desc: Generate PDF but do not send email.

response: {ok, email_sent_to, pdf_url, rows, closing_balance, lines, total_outstanding, note?}

name: finance-storefront
summary: Public online storefront: browse products and submit cart checkout
description: Anonymous action-discriminated endpoint for the workspace's public mini-store. 'meta' returns storefront config, 'products' returns published products with prices, 'checkout' validates the cart server-side, creates a draft retail receipt (myDATA 11.1), and returns a Stripe pay link. Requires the sales-finance module for checkout.

actions.name: meta
actions.summary: Return storefront config and workspace branding for a given slug

actions.name: products
actions.summary: List storefront-published products with gross prices
actions.response: {ok, products: [{product_id, name, description, unit, item_type, price, currency, image_url}]}

actions.name: checkout
actions.summary: Submit cart, create draft retail receipt, return Stripe pay link

params.name: items
params.desc: Cart line items; prices are always recomputed server-side.

name: flow-engine
summary: Execute, test, or event-trigger workflow automations by walking the xyflow graph.
description: Requires Supabase JWT. Routes on body.action to execute-flow (run a saved flow with trigger data), test-flow (dry-run, no side effects), or trigger-event (auto-dispatch from DB triggers or server-to-server).

actions.name: execute-flow
actions.summary: Run a flow with provided trigger data; writes execution record to flow_runs.

params.name: flow_id
params.desc: UUID of the flow to execute.

params.name: trigger_data
params.desc: Arbitrary payload passed as trigger context into the graph.

actions.response: {success: boolean, data: {id: string, status: string, results: object}}

actions.name: test-flow
actions.summary: Dry-run a flow: resolves templates and evaluates conditions but does not fire actions.

params.name: flow_id
params.desc: UUID of the flow to test.

actions.response: {success: boolean, data: {id: string, status: string, results: object}}

actions.name: trigger-event
actions.summary: Auto-dispatch flows whose trigger_type matches the event type; used by DB triggers and internal services.

params.name: event_data
params.desc: Event payload merged into trigger context.

request.name: action
request.desc: One of: execute-flow | test-flow | trigger-event

name: flow-scheduler-cron
summary: Per-minute cron that fires scheduled flows whose cron expression matches current UTC time.
description: Validates x-cron-secret, fetches active flows with trigger_type='scheduled', evaluates their cron expression against the current time (with timezone support), and invokes flow-engine execute-flow for each due flow. Prevents double-firing with a 55-second last_run_at guard.
response: {success: boolean, checked: number, triggered: number, results: array}

name: flow-webhook
summary: Receives external HTTP requests and routes them to the matching webhook-triggered flow.
description: Requires flow_id as a query parameter. Validates that the flow has trigger_type='webhook' and is active. Optionally verifies an X-Webhook-Secret header against the secret stored in the flow's trigger_config before delegating to flow-engine execute-flow.

request.name: flow_id
request.desc: UUID of the webhook-triggered flow to execute.

response: {success: boolean, data: {flow_id: string, run_id: string, status: string}}

name: generate-catalog-pdf
summary: Render a presentation catalog to a PDF and store it in pdf-documents
description: Builds a multi-page A3 PDF from the catalog's cover/body/back-cover data and selected template, uploads it to pdf-documents/catalog-output/{id}/, and updates presentation_catalogs with the storage path and a fresh signed URL.

request.name: catalog_id
request.desc: presentation_catalogs row ID to render

name: generate-interior-gemini
summary: Multi-mode interior design image generation (Gemini, FLUX, Grok)
description: Generates interior design images across seven modes: text-to-image, image-edit, redesign, copy-style, floor-plan-render, floor-plan-text, and materials-selection-board. Routes to Gemini (flash 6cr / pro 15cr), FLUX Depth Pro (redesign/copy-style 20cr), or Grok Aurora (15cr) based on mode and model_tier. Accepts service-role key for server-to-server calls from agent-chat; otherwise requires user JWT.

model_tier.description: Model quality tier: fast=Gemini flash (6cr), pro=Gemini pro (15cr), grok=Grok Aurora (15cr)

material_images.description: Up to 14 catalog product image URLs for multi-reference Gemini generation

reference_image_url.description: Source image URL for image-edit and floor-plan-render modes

edit_instruction.description: Instruction describing what to change in image-edit mode

style_reference_url.description: Second uploaded image: style/mood reference for copy-style and redesign modes

user_id.description: Required when called with service-role key (server-to-server)

name: generate-interior-video-v2
summary: Multi-model interior design video generation with async polling fallback
description: Generates interior design videos via veo-2 (30cr), kling-v3.0 (20cr), wan2.1-i2v-720p (12cr), or runway-gen4-turbo (40cr). Model is auto-selected from video_type when not specified. Replicate-based models poll for up to 50s and return async job_id if not done; frontend polls generation_videos table. Accepts service-role key for agent-chat internal calls.

source_image_url.description: Required. Public URL of the source interior image

video_type.description: Video type; drives auto model selection. Default: walkthrough

model.description: Explicit model override; if omitted, auto-selected from video_type

prompt.description: Optional generation prompt; model defaults apply if omitted

before_image_url.description: Before image for before_after video type (Replicate models)

user_id.description: Required when called with service-role key (server-to-server)

async_job.description: True when generation is still in progress

prediction_id.description: Replicate prediction ID for client-side polling

name: generate-moodboard-sheet-pdf
summary: Render a moodboard presentation sheet or project client-view to PDF
description: Accepts either a sheet_id (renders one of the 9 sheet types: material_board, color_palette, concept_board, lighting_plan, annotated_render, elevation_render_pair, ffe_schedule, area_breakdown, full_deck) or a client_view_id (renders a cross-moodboard project deck). Uploads to pdf-documents and returns a 7-day signed URL.

request.name: sheet_id
request.desc: moodboard_presentation_sheets row ID; required when client_view_id is absent

request.name: client_view_id
request.desc: project_client_views row ID; required when sheet_id is absent

request.name: regenerate
request.desc: Force re-render even if a completed PDF already exists (client view path only)

name: generate-contract-pdf
summary: Render a signed/draft contract to PDF
description: Renders the contract (with any collected signatures) to a PDF, overwrites it at pdf-documents/contract-output/{contract_id}.pdf (private bucket), and returns a 7-day signed URL. Requires a signed-in user; the caller is reconciled against the contract's workspace before rendering (#250 invariant 1).

request.name: contract_id
request.desc: contracts row ID to render

name: marketplace-price-check
summary: Check a surplus-listing price against the Operator's market cap
description: Resolves the market price for a product (via MIVAA's market-check engine — Perplexity/DataForSEO/Firecrawl) and returns whether a proposed surplus listing price is within the Operator cap (market_median × (1 + cap%), default 20%). Same guard create_marketplace_listing enforces server-side so the client can't forge it. authenticate() + userCanAccessWorkspace(); workspace must be an approved marketplace participant.

request.name: product_id
request.desc: product_id OR product_name is required

request.name: price
request.desc: Proposed listing price to test against the cap

response: { success, market_median, market_min, market_max, currency, cap_pct, max_allowed, allowed, unverified, from_cache }

name: seo-domain-tracker
summary: Weekly Rankings + Backlinks snapshots for a connected website
description: Snapshots DataForSEO domain rank overview (ranking keywords, organic traffic, position buckets, up/down/new/lost) + backlinks summary (backlinks, referring domains, spam score) + top ranked keywords for the site's MARKET (resolved from its GSC top country, else TLD, else US) into seo_domain_snapshots + seo_domain_keywords. verify_jwt disabled so the weekly cron-run (x-cron-secret) works; the run action calls authenticate()+userCanAccessWorkspace().

actions.description: Snapshot one website's rankings + backlinks now.
x-cron-secret only — weekly snapshot of every active connected website.

name: seo-site-audit
summary: Site Health — homepage Lighthouse + on-page audit for a connected website
description: Runs a synchronous homepage audit (DataForSEO instant-page + Google Lighthouse) via MIVAA's quick-page route and stores Core Web Vitals / SEO / accessibility / best-practices scores + failing-audit issues in website_health_audits. verify_jwt disabled so the weekly cron-run (x-cron-secret) works; the run action calls authenticate()+userCanAccessWorkspace(). name: viva-webhooks
summary: Viva.com payment webhook receiver + verification-key handshake (multi-tenant BYOK)
description:
#273 Phase 2 - Viva.com webhooks, multi-tenant BYOK. Two surfaces:

- GET  - the verification-key handshake Viva performs at webhook registration. The key is per-merchant, so the caller passes ?workspace_id=<uuid> to say which tenant is registering; the function fetches that workspace's key from Viva and echoes it back.
- POST - the event deliveries: 1796 payment created, 1797 reversal created, 1798 payment failed, 2054 account transaction (merchant-level, covers incoming RF bank transfers).

SECURITY: Viva payment webhooks carry NO per-message signature (Viva-Signature-256 exists only on their Data Services contract, which has a shared secret; payment webhooks have none), so there is nothing to verify per delivery. Invariant #6 is satisfied differently and more strongly: THE WEBHOOK IS A TRIGGER, NEVER DATA - the handler reads the transaction back from Viva's API and acts on that, so a forged delivery cannot inject state.

get.description: Returns the workspace's Viva verification key so Viva can complete webhook registration. Requires ?workspace_id=<uuid>. 400 if missing, 503 if Viva is not configured for that workspace (`viva_not_configured`), 502 if the key fetch fails.

query.name: workspace_id
query.desc: Tenant whose Viva verification key is being fetched (the key is per-merchant)

request.name: EventTypeId
request.desc: 1796 payment created | 1797 reversal created | 1798 payment failed | 2054 account transaction

request.name: EventData
request.desc: Viva event payload. Treated as a TRIGGER ONLY - the transaction is read back from Viva's API before any state change.

response: { ok } (always 200 to Viva once accepted; processing errors are logged, not surfaced)
